note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.bar: There is no sourced street EPS line. Morgans (downgrade to Hold, target $6.40, week of 6 Oct 2026) expects 'a mid-single digit decline in 2H26 earnings (ex notable costs)' on 1H cash NPAT of $176m, i.e. roughly $165-170m in 2H. Consensus FY26 EPS is about 47.7-49c (FNArena; Yahoo shows 0.49 across 12 analysts, revised down from 0.53 over 90 days). The 14-analyst target is $6.27-6.29, below the $6.49 spot. Sources: https://www.ibtimes.com.au/boq-shares-rise-ahead-full-year-results-1876599 , https://www.fnarena.com/index.php/analysis-data/consensus-forecasts/stock-analysis/?code=BOQ , https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260422/pdf/06yqn40qfhs68p.pdf. Two partly agreeing estimate sources plus a company statement, so sizes are not capped, but the bar is loose.
hunter_view.positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 4.49% (29.6m shares) as of 2026-10-08, up from 4.23% on 10-01 (+0.26pp, building), lag 4 sessions. This is elevated for an ASX bank, and sentiment is bearish (1 Buy / 7 Hold / 6 Sell, average target below spot), so the bar is low and a crowded short is fuel against a negative. The baseline lean already carries this at +2.2. Over the lag the stock went 6.38 -> 6.69 -> 6.49; it fell 3.0% on 14 Oct with the sector (BEN -3.5%, CBA -2.2%), so nothing idiosyncratic happened into the seal. I did not size positioning as a separate finding, because it would only restate the baseline lean.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: Mild agreement. The lean is +2.2, driven by a 4.5% and building short, and my evidence leans faintly positive (margin tailwind, capital surplus, low sell-side bar) against a negative volume read. The findings do not beat the lean; they sit well inside it.

findings.finding: APRA's monthly ADI statistics show BOQ's resident housing loans fell from $52,790m (Feb 2026) to $50,731m (Aug 2026), -$2,059m or -3.9% over 2H26. That is the same pace as 1H26 (-$2,095m from Aug 2025), against the 1H26 guide that 'home lending contraction [is] easing'. Total resident deposits fell 3.1% ($68,791m to $66,648m). Two caveats: Jul-Aug flattened (Aug -$2m), and business loans rose to $15,827m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 1H26 (22 Apr 2026): retail GLA fell $1.5bn and NIM fell 3bp; the stock moved -9.08%, the worst of five observed prints. FY25 (15 Oct 2025): +1.40%.

findings.finding: Rising cash rates point to a 2H26 margin lift. BOQ's 1H26 deck lists '2H26 considerations: benefits from an increasing cash rate environment, replicating portfolio and hedging benefits, ... tailwinds from TD spreads, deposit pricing and funding mix'. Peer Bendigo & Adelaide reported a 2H26 NIM of 1.98%, up 6bp half on half, on deposit mix, TD repricing and the replicating portfolio (results 18 Aug 2026).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NIM -3bp at 1H26 -> -9.08%. NIM +10bp y/y at FY25 (1.67% vs 1.57% the half before) -> +1.40%.

findings.finding: Capital is still in surplus and the buyback is mostly unspent. BOQ's 10 Aug release gives a pro-forma CET1 of 11.01% after the $295m return, against a 10.25-10.75% target range. The 1 Sep Appendix 3C shows only about 1.72m shares (about $11.1m) of the $196m on-market buyback bought before the results blackout. So about $185m resumes after the print, and the surplus above the range invites an upsize or a final-dividend payout at the top of 60-75%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The capital return announcement on 10 Aug 2026 is not in the results history and I did not measure its reaction. No observed result in the history carried a capital-return surprise.

findings.finding: The 2H26 notable items and the cost outcome were pre-released on 10 Aug 2026: a $47m pre-tax ($33m post-tax) technology and asset impairment, excluded from the final dividend base, and 'Excluding this notable item, BOQ is on track to meet guidance of sub-inflation expense growth for FY26'. That removes most of the kitchen-sink and cost-miss risk at the first full-year result under CEO Rod Finch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At 1H26, a $31m post-tax held-for-sale loss sat in statutory profit and the stock fell -9.08%, though cash earnings and NIM were the drivers.

findings.finding: The 1H26 deck warns that 'there may be further statutory impacts recognised in 2H26, upon completion' of the Challenger whole-of-loan sale, which completed 1 May 2026. The 10 Aug release did not quantify any such item, so a further statutory loss is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the same held-for-sale line as at 1H26 ($31m post-tax loss, -9.08% day, with other drivers).
